title: Stages or locations with no takeoff
question: When a stage or location has no planned quantity in a takeoff project, what should users see?
context: The historical PRD says to show a notice and let users enter the missing value (PROG-REQ-009). The code falls back to using the measured value as its own denominator, so the item looks 100% complete (PROG-REQ-008).
options: Show "no takeoff" and exclude it from percentages
Show the notice and prompt for entry
